method: Local next dev of this worktree; Playwright Chromium (1440x900, 390x844, 360x780) and WebKit (390x844), DPR 2. /api/road-bearing stubbed with four one-way candidates (Overpass unavailable 2026-10-25) and held until the 'Detecting road�' footer was measured; geocode and the rest live. Pointer parked at the viewport's bottom-right corner before every measure and shot. Rects are getBoundingClientRect in CSS px; lines = distinct client-rect tops of the element's text. edgePoints: elementFromPoint at y in {1,4,vh-4,vh-1} x x in {1,vw/2,vw-1}; 'outside' counts points not inside the dialog. reach: each road row scrolled into view (block nearest) in its scroller, then its centre and bottom edge hit-tested and its bottom compared with the footer's top.
note: Playwright WebKit is not a real iPhone; iOS Safari is unchecked.
